title: Molecular analysis of the interaction between ubiquitin-specific protease 7 and large T antigen of Merkel cell polyomavirus.
authors: Lim, Dahwan; Park, Jung-Hwan; Shin, Ho-Chul; Kim, Seung Jun; Ku, Bonsu
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold建模和生化分析研究Usp7与MCPyV大T抗原的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及结构建模但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制关联较弱。
abstract: Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCPyV) is the primary causative agent of Merkel cell carcinoma, a rare but highly aggressive neuroendocrine skin cancer. Large T antigen (LT), one of two oncoproteins encoded by MCPyV, sustains the proliferation of MCPyV-infected tumor cells. LT contains multiple protein-binding motifs that mediate interactions with diverse host proteins essential for its function. Among these, ubiquitin-specific protease 7 (Usp7), a deubiquitinase that regulates the stability of multiple substrates, including p53, is a recently identified LT-interacting protein. In the present study, we characterized the intermolecular interaction between Usp7 and MCPyV LT using biochemical analyses and AlphaFold-based structural modeling. Our results demonstrate that MCPyV LT directly interacts with the TRAF domain of Usp7 via a unique binding motif that is distinct from the canonical sequence. Moreover, MCPyV LT attenuates the p53-deubiquitinating activity of Usp7, providing insights into the molecular function of this viral oncoprotein.
abstract_zh: 默克尔细胞多瘤病毒（MCPyV）是默克尔细胞癌的主要致病因子，这是一种罕见但高度侵袭性的神经内分泌皮肤癌。大T抗原（LT）是MCPyV编码的两种癌蛋白之一，维持着MCPyV感染肿瘤细胞的增殖。LT包含多个蛋白质结合基序，这些基序介导与其功能所必需的各种宿主蛋白的相互作用。其中，泛素特异性蛋白酶7（Usp7）是一种去泛素化酶，调节包括p53在内的多种底物的稳定性，是最近鉴定的LT相互作用蛋白。在本研究中，我们通过生化分析和基于AlphaFold的结构建模，表征了Usp7与MCPyV LT之间的分子间相互作用。我们的结果表明，MCPyV LT通过一个独特的结合基序直接与Usp7的TRAF结构域相互作用，该基序不同于典型序列。此外，MCPyV LT减弱了Usp7的p53去泛素化活性，为这种病毒癌蛋白的分子功能提供了见解。
